items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: That’s what’s important. That’s how good he played. Great artist. In fact, he was one of the Four Horsemen. They called them the Four Horsemen: Billy Gladstone, Max Manne – Shelly Manne’s father – the tympany player . . .
Sol Goodman? Vic Firth? Sol Goodman? No?
